senses.gloss: happening once every year or relating to one year

translations.vi_VN: hàng năm; mỗi năm một lần

definition_translations.zh_TW: 每年發生一次的，或與一年有關的
definition_translations.ja_JP: 年に一度起こる、または一年に関する
definition_translations.vi_VN: xảy ra mỗi năm một lần hoặc liên quan đến một năm
definition_translations.th_TH: เกิดขึ้นปีละครั้ง หรือเกี่ยวกับหนึ่งปี

senses.example: The company reviews its safety procedures yearly.

example_translations.zh_TW: 該公司每年檢討一次安全程序。
example_translations.ja_JP: その会社は安全手順を毎年見直している。
example_translations.ko_KR: 그 회사는 매년 안전 절차를 검토한다.
example_translations.vi_VN: Công ty xem xét lại các quy trình an toàn hằng năm.
example_translations.th_TH: บริษัททบทวนขั้นตอนความปลอดภัยเป็นประจำทุกปี

translations.th_TH: แนวทางรายปี
อยู่เป็นประจำทุกปี
